protocol.failure_rule: charged, recorded as NULL, excluded from the GP
protocol.gp: fixed RBF length_scale=0.25 + WhiteKernel(1e-4), normalised y, no hyper-optimisation
protocol.hot_start_rule: learning arms: three lowest predicted means; SOBOL_BO: first three pool points
protocol.target: log(CDi / J_ref) with J_ref from the S1 baseline anchor of the same task
